raw.title: Business Development Director (DACH)
raw.description:
About the Role 

Imagine this. You are the person German, Austrian and Swiss defence customers call first when they want to understand what is actually possible, and the person inside Destinus who turns that conversation into a funded programme. 

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations. 

This role sits in the Future Capabilities organisation of Destinus Germany and reports to the Chief Future Capabilities Officer. You lead senior business development for the DACH region and open the doors that future capability programmes need in order to exist at all. 

You will build the DACH BD team. The measure of this role is the forces commitments that turn advanced technology into procurement-ready capability for the region. You work as one team across the company: with Commercial on pricing, contracting and pipeline, with Engineering on what is technically achievable.  

 

What You’ll Do 

  • Build and lead senior business development for Germany, Austria and Switzerland, covering armed forces, procurement authorities, security agencies and industrial partners. 
  • Open and hold senior access at BMVg, BAAINBw, Bundeswehr commands, national agencies and NATO bodies, in close coordination with Destinus government relations. 
  • Shape future demand: translate what customers and users actually need into requirements input the capability teams can build against. 
  • Run capture for DACH opportunities from qualification through to first customer commitment, together with Commercial on the commercial shape and with Engineering on what is technically achievable. 
  • Build, lead and develop a team of business developers, and set the standard for how Destinus shows up in front of German customers. 
  • Work as one commercial motion with the Commercial organisation: one CRM, one pipeline, every opportunity visible to everyone who needs it. 
  • Own joint account plans for the key DACH accounts 
  • Feed a clear and honest view of the DACH market back into portfolio and capability decisions. 

Requirements

What You’ll Need 

  • Substantial senior business development or capture experience in defence, security or adjacent deep technology, with a record of closing first commitments. 
  • Deep working knowledge of German defence procurement: how requirements form, how budget lines come about, how tenders and framework contracts run, and where decisions are actually made. 
  • An established senior network across BMVg, BAAINBw, the Bundeswehr, national agencies, research organisations and German industry. 
  • The ability to hold your own in a technical discussion and to bring engineers into a customer conversation at the right moment. 
  • Proven ability to deliver in a matrix organisation, building strong working relationships across commercial, engineering and programme teams. 
  • Experience building, leading and developing small senior teams, including hiring. 
  • Aerospace and defence industry experience is mandatory. 
  • Fluency in English and German is required. 

 

Who You Are  

You are comfortable being early. This is a build role in a young organisation, and much of the structure around you will be created as you go. You are a translator by instinct, between operator and engineer, between customer need and product concept, between Germany and a European group. You qualify hard and early, and you are straight with colleagues and customers about what you see. You enjoy the matrix and you bring people from other functions with you. You hold yourself to what you promised a customer, and you travel to be in the room when it matters.

raw.description:
ABOUT US

METYCLE - where innovation meets sustainability

We are building the B2B online platform to accelerate the global circular flow of secondary metals. By connecting buyers and sellers of scrap metal globally, we enable efficient trade of secondary metals and drive the seamless flow of recycling material, essential for reducing CO2 emissions by up to 95% compared to primary metal production.

And we take it further! We are pioneering an innovative Smart Sorting Facility that leverages AI, machine learning, and robotics to transform how scrap metal is processed, enhance material quality, improve traceability, and drive the recycling industry into the digital era.

Join us at the early stage in bringing the $610 billion scrap metal trading industry into the 21st century and in shaping the future of metal recycling and green energy solutions.


READY TO MAKE AN IMPACT?

If you are passionate about industrial automation, solving complex technical challenges, and building something from the ground up, join our team as an Industrial Automation Engineer.

The machinery is the easy part to buy. The control system that turns it into a plant - and the standards, documentation, and data that keep it running - is what we are hiring you to own.

We are looking for an experienced Industrial Automation Engineer to take ownership of our plant’s control systems from design through commissioning and into stable production. You bring deep hands-on experience in programming and commissioning industrial control systems and are comfortable taking responsibility for the PLC, safety systems, HMI, industrial networking, and interfaces between multiple machine suppliers.

Beyond programming, you understand what it takes to make a plant genuinely reliable in production and have the technical confidence to hold suppliers to high professional standards. Join our international team, help build innovative solutions for scrap metal processing, and contribute to a more sustainable future.


YOUR MISSION

  • PLC & Plant Control: Design, write, and own the PLC program using Siemens TIA Portal / S7-1200 & S7-1500, including control logic, sequencing, fault handling, and HMI
  • Commissioning & Production: Take the plant from design through commissioning to a stable, running line, owning the full journey through FAT/SAT and the hands-on work required to make the plant genuinely reliable
  • Plant Availability: Design stop and interlock behaviour to minimise unnecessary downtime — allowing unaffected parts of the plant to keep running when it is safe to do so. Plant availability is a direct business outcome here, and you will directly influence it
  • Machine Safety: Implement the machine-safety control concept on a fail-safe F-CPU with F-I/O, including the hardwired e-stop loop, PLC-enforced zone isolation that cannot be overridden, guard interlocks, and controlled, sequenced shutdown
  • Safety & Compliance: Be our in-house technical counterpart on EN ISO 13849 performance-level determination and the CE file, working with external assessors while retaining ownership of the technical approach and decisions
  • Machine Integration: Integrate control systems from several different machine suppliers into one coherent line, so that a single stop is genuinely a single stop across the whole plant
  • Supplier Management: Hold machine builders and panel builders to specification, including unlocked code, complete documentation, and standards compliance
  • OT / IT & Industrial IoT: Get plant data out over OPC UA / MQTT / Modbus TCP into our own systems, so stoppage reasons, energy use, and throughput become actionable data. Work closely with our Industrial IoT team, who own the edge and data side of that boundary


YOUR PROFILE

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience programming and commissioning industrial control systems, with a track record of bringing production equipment or complete lines into stable operation
  • Deep Siemens TIA Portal / S7-1200 & S7-1500 experience, with strong skills in SCL, LAD/FBD, HMI/SCADA, industrial networking (PROFINET, PROFIBUS, Modbus TCP), drives/VFDs, and fault-finding
  • Strong machine safety competence, including F-CPU / Safety Integrated and EN ISO 13849, with the ability to explain and defend performance-level determinations
  • Comfortable reading electrical schematics and troubleshooting cabinets, hardware, signals, wiring, and control behaviour directly on the shop floor. You have brought at least one production line from commissioning into stable production; maintenance-only experience is not sufficient
  • Experience working with machine and panel builders, with the confidence to hold suppliers accountable for code quality, documentation, standards compliance, and professional delivery
  • Experience with brownfield projects and legacy migration (STEP 7 Classic → TIA); experience in bulk material handling, recycling, sorting, or minerals processing is a plus
  • Experience with PLC version control, simulation / digital twins, or structured automation approaches is desirable. Additional IT/OT skills such as Python, C#/TIA Openness, SQL, Linux, Docker, MES/IIoT, OT network segmentation, or IEC 62443 are a plus
  • Independent, structured, and hands-on, with a strong sense of ownership. You challenge assumptions, hold suppliers to a high standard, and document what you build
  • Fluent in English; German and/or Dutch is a plus. Ideally based in or near Cologne or the Benelux/border region, with valid EU work authorisation and the willingness to travel to our Smart Sorting Facility in Belgium, Maasmechelen


WHY JOIN US?

As SCADA Engineering Manager, you take technical ownership of SCADA, monitoring, plant control and communication systems for our utility-scale PV and BESS projects. raw.title: Senior Ground Software Engineer
raw.description:
Help Build Europe's Hypersonic Capability
 
At Hypersonica, we’re redefining what’s possible in European defence technology. We exist to deliver speed, resilience, and technological independence at a pace that sets a new standard. We are a small, elite team working on problems that matter, and solving them fast.
 
By joining Hypersonica, you’re not stepping into a predefined role. You’re joining a talent dense environment where every individual shapes the direction of the company. Our philosophy is to hire a small number of exceptional people with broad, deep technical capability, strong judgement, and the ability to operate autonomously.
 
We hire for talent, not rigid boxes. This role represents a business need, but the way it evolves will be shaped by the individual. If you’ve achieved what others said was impossible, or you bring a unique combination of skills that doesn’t fit a traditional mould, we want to hear from you. The work you do here directly contributes to Europe’s technological independence.

What you'll do

  • Design and develop ground software used for mission preparation, execution, and monitoring of hypersonic systems. 

  • Build robust, user facing applications for Linux and Windows environments that support operators and engineers during real missions. 

  • Implement high performance C++ software with a focus on reliability, usability, and maintainability. 

  • Develop intuitive user interfaces and workflows to visualise system state, mission data, and operational status. 

  • Integrate ground software with simulation, test, and live system interfaces to support end to end operations. 

  • Work closely with systems, GNC, test, and operations teams to translate mission needs into effective software tools. 

  • Where useful, leverage UI frameworks (e.g. Qt) and mapping or visualisation SDKs to accelerate development. 


Who you are

  • A Senior software engineer with 5+ years’ experience building ground or operator-facing software in aerospace, defence, or complex technical domains. 

  • Comfortable developing user-facing applications on Linux and Windows, with an understanding of operational reliability. 

  • Fluent in modern C++, with an instinct for performance, robustness, and clean architecture. 

  • Someone who cares deeply about operator experience, clarity, and usability in high-pressure environments. 

  • Experienced translating mission and system needs into practical software tools, not just features. 

  • Pragmatic about tooling, with exposure to UI frameworks such as Qt and an interest in visualisation or mapping technologies. 

  • Able to move quickly in a startup environment, balancing polish with delivery speed. 

  • Motivated by building software that operators trust during real missions, not demo-only systems. 


What we offer

  • A mission driven environment with the opportunity to work on one of Europe’s most consequential defence challenges, with direct impact on sovereign capability and security. 

  • Daily collaboration with top experts across engineering, operations, and defence, with real opportunity to learn from the best, contribute, and grow. 

  • High ownership and autonomy; no time tracking, no micromanagement, just clear objectives and accountability for outcomes. 

  • A fast paced environment where good ideas are implemented quickly, and feedback from test and flight drives real decisions. 

  • A culture that values clarity, integrity, and excellence, and supports people who take initiative and push boundaries responsibly. 

  • Competitive compensation and real share options aligned to responsibility and impact, not tenure or hierarchy. 

At Hypersonica, every hire raises the bar. We are deliberately small, intensely capable, and deeply mission-driven. If this role feels like a strong fit, or if you believe you bring something exceptional that goes beyond the description, we encourage you to apply.
 
Hypersonica is an equal-opportunity employer and assesses candidates solely on merit, capability, and potential.
 
You can apply directly to this role or reach out to Nathan Sweeney, Head of Talent. We review every application and aim to respond to all candidates within two weeks, whether the answer is yes or no.

description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><span data-sheets-root="1">About Wolt</span></h2> <p><span data-sheets-root="1">At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.<br><br>Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.</span></p></div><p>Wolt is a Finnish technology company known for its local commerce platform. From food delivery to grocery stores and cosmetics, we make cities better places to live by connecting people with the things they need. Our Global Creative Production team is currently undergoing a massive transformation, shifting from a reactive service center to an "upstream AI-Enabled growth engine".</p> <p>We are looking for a <strong>Senior Creative Producer </strong>to join us at this pivotal moment.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>This is a 6-month fixed contract opportunity starting ASAP.&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>Location: Helsinki, Berlin, Athens, Stockholm, Copenhagen&nbsp;</strong></p> <h2>What you’ll be doing</h2> <p>As the Senior Creative Producer, you will manage digital projects from brief to final delivery. You’ll thrive in cross-functional collaboration across different business departments such as B2B, Communication, New Verticals, and Wolt+ teams. You’ll own project timelines for successful deliveries,&nbsp; weekly standups, daily communication with stakeholders and creative teams, and the localization and QA process during the production of social and digital assets.&nbsp;</p> <p>You will own the end-to-end production of digital advertising projects, ensuring our creative assets are not only on-brand but also built for massive scale across global markets. You will be responsible for the day-to-day organization of the team and daily communication from brief to delivery.&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>Day-to-day in this role, you’ll:</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>End-to-End Delivery:</strong> Manage digital projects and multi-channel campaigns from concept to launch. Our deliverables touch social, in-app, DOOH, event collateral, and OOH.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Resource &amp; Budget Control:</strong> Oversee project costs, timelines, and team allocations without losing creative quality.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Stakeholder Management:</strong> Align internal marketing teams, designers, and external agencies on project milestones and timelines. Daily and/or weekly status updates are crucial for the success of our projects.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Time Management &amp; Multitasking</strong>: Excellent time management skills with the ability to set priorities, multitask, and meet deadlines. Our producers are working on multiple projects simultaneously, and projects might touch different surfaces each time.</li> </ul> <h2>Our humble expectations&nbsp;</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Solid Production Experience:</strong> 8+ years in creative production or integrated campaign management, ideally within a high-growth tech environment or a progressive digital agency.</li> <li><strong>Understanding of Media Plans</strong>: You have experience with specs and asset production across Awareness, Consideration, and Conversion layers.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Stakeholder Management:</strong> Ability to manage complex projects with multiple high-level stakeholders while maintaining high creative standards. Demonstrated success partnering with distributed teams across time zones and cultures</li> <li><strong>Risk Management &amp; Reporting</strong>: Ability to assess risks during production, find solutions, and share with management and stakeholders in a timely manner.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Organizational skills</strong>: Methodical in following a predetermined system to complete tasks and meticulous in paying close attention to small details without losing sight of the big picture.</li> <li><strong>Strong work ethic and accountability</strong>: A proactive attitude and rigor on everyday tasks, a positive mindset despite ongoing changes, and an excitement to learn. Resourceful during productions; deciding and acting on whether to bring external and/or internal resources and self-motivated to lead the project to completion. Someone who doesn’t shy away from a challenge and follows through on commitments made.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Tech-Forward Mindset:</strong> You have a strong interest (and ideally experience) in AI-powered creative tools and generative workflows.</li> </ul> <h2>What we offer</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Shape the Future:</strong> You won’t just be filling a seat; you’ll be building the blueprint for how Wolt produces creative content for years to come.</li> <li><strong>Innovation at Scale:</strong> Work at the forefront of AI and automation in the creative industry, moving from manual tasks to agentic workflows.</li> <li><strong>Impact:</strong> Take ownership of strategic business priorities and see your work scale globally.</li> <li><strong>Wolt Culture:</strong> Join a team that values ownership, heart, and a "get things done" attitude in a hybrid, flexible work environment.</li> </ul> <h2>Next steps</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Application Review:</strong> Our Production team will review your profile to see if your experience aligns with our strategy.</li> <li><strong>TA Screen:</strong> A 30-minute introductory call to discuss your background and motivations.</li> <li><strong>Hiring Manager Interview:</strong> A deep dive into your production philosophy with our Creative Production Lead.</li> <li><strong>Loop: Competency &amp; Operating Principles: </strong>a structured behavioural interview with the team.</li> <li><strong>Working Session:</strong> a short case study and walk us through your thinking.<br><br><iframe style="display: table; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/GoL541_xj9w" width="720" height="404"></iframe></li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><span data-sheets-root="1">Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion</span></h2> <p><span data-sheets-root="1">We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.</span></p> <p><em>Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at <span class="_80om1qgj _1e0c1nu9" data-testid="smart-link-draggable-inline"><span class="loader-wrapper"><span class="hover-card-trigger-wrapper" data-testid="hover-card-trigger-wrapper"><a class="_1yt4x7n9 _2rko1ssi _v56415x0 _1e0c1nu9 _16d9qvcn _syaz13af _1rkwglyw _4cvx1w55 _19itia51 _bfhkhp5a _1a3b18uv _4fprglyw _5goinqa1 _9oik18uv _1bnxglyw _jf4cnqa1 _1nrm18uv _c2waglyw _1iohnqa1 _uizt1kdv _nt751r31 _49pcglyw _1hvw1o36 _1372tlke _7ehiw5lj _1j5pglyw _1di615s3" href="https://careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness" data-testid="inline-card-resolved-view"><span class="_19itglyw _vchhusvi _r06hglyw _o5721jtm _1nmz9jpi _16d9qvcn _ca0qv77o _u5f31b66 _n3tdv77o _19bv1b66" data-testid="inline-card-icon-and-title"><span class="_19itglyw _vchhusvi _r06hglyw">Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash</span></span></a></span></span></span> .</em></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Master Data Management Lead (gn)
description: <p><span class="TextRun MacChromeBold SCXW104639616 BCX0" lang="EN-US" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW104639616 BCX0"><strong data-start="240" data-end="250">Start:</strong> 01.01.2027&nbsp;| Level: Lead | Location: Germany, remote | Working hours: Fulltime (40h/week)<br><br>As<strong> </strong>Master Data Management Lead, you will bear overall strategic responsibility for master data management across the entire company. In this role, you will define the governance structure, set priorities for MDM initiatives, and ensure that data ownership, decision-making rights, and processes are clearly established. You will act as the central interface between business strategy and operational data.<br><br>The role can be performed remotely from anywhere within Germany, with occasional visits to our headquarters in Hamburg (approximately once per month during the first year, with less frequent visits possible thereafter)<br></span></span></p> <h3><strong>Your mission</strong></h3> <ul> <li data-path-to-node="7,0,0">You are responsible for the global MDM strategy, the roadmap, and the data governance framework, as well as defining clear data responsibilities (Data Ownership)</li> <li data-path-to-node="7,1,0">You will build a central MDM Center of Competence (CoC) within the TQG Group, establish standards, and ensure the internal development of expertise</li> <li data-path-to-node="7,2,0">You will lead the MDM team functionally and disciplinary, and coordinate the Business and Technical Data Stewards</li> <li data-path-to-node="7,3,0">You will design the Master Data Operating Model (MDOM) as well as end-to-end, cross-domain master data processes (Product, Customer, Supplier, Finance, Logistics)</li> <li data-path-to-node="7,4,0">You will act as a bridge to the business units (SCM, Sales, Finance, etc.) and lead strategic governance committees</li> <li data-path-to-node="7,5,0">You will define and monitor MDM metrics (KPIs) using dashboards and drive continuous improvement processes</li> <li data-path-to-node="7,6,0">You will work closely with the MDM data architecture team to optimally translate strategic guidelines into technical solutions</li> <li data-path-to-node="7,6,0">You will actively promote a cultural shift toward active data ownership across the entire organization</li> </ul> <h3>Your experience &amp; skills</h3> <ul> <li data-path-to-node="10,0,0">You bring at least 7 years of profound professional experience in the field of MDM, data governance, or data-driven transformation projects</li> <li data-path-to-node="10,1,0">Ideally, you possess solid industry expertise in FMCG, food, dietary supplements, or retail</li> <li data-path-to-node="10,2,0">You have proven leadership competence in cross-departmental projects as well as experience in building MDM governance structures in medium-sized companies</li> <li data-path-to-node="10,3,0">You understand end-to-end master data processes (especially Product, Customer, Supplier, and Finance) down to the smallest detail</li> <li data-path-to-node="10,4,0">You have sound knowledge of SAP S/4HANA within the master data context and are familiar with systems such as ERP, PIM (e.g., Akeneo), CRM, WMS, or PLM (e.g., Centric)</li> <li data-path-to-node="10,5,0">You possess practical know-how regarding data models and system integrations</li> <li data-path-to-node="10,6,0">You are characterized by a structured, analytical, and strategic mindset, paired with a documentation quality suitable for top-management level</li> <li data-path-to-node="10,7,0">You convince with strong communication and moderation skills to drive organizational change, and you are fluent in both German and English</li> </ul> <h3>Why choose us?</h3> <p>Being part of our team means joining a high-performing company with a diverse and inclusive culture. In our fast-growing team of over 1,200 employees, we combine our passion for sports nutrition, supplements, and healthy foods with cutting-edge technology, production, and logistics processes. All of this serves one goal: providing our customers with top-quality products to support their healthy and active lifestyle.</p> <p>You can look forward to a strong sense of team spirit, ongoing opportunities for professional growth and responsibility, and an exciting work environment that blends lifestyle and career. With locations in Hamburg, Elmshorn, Kaltenkirchen/Nützen, and Elsdorf, TQG offers diverse career opportunities in areas such as technology, product development, sales, marketing, and logistics. Additionally, you’ll benefit from:</p> <ul> <li>Flexible working hours and remote work options</li> <li>Attractive employee discounts</li> <li>Subsidy for the E-gym Wellpass</li> <li>Workation</li> <li>Corporate benefits</li> <li>28 days vacation/year</li> <li>and much more</li> </ul> <h3>About Us</h3> <p>The Quality Group (TQG) is an innovative provider of sports nutrition products, bringing together the successful brands&nbsp;<strong>ESN&nbsp;</strong>and&nbsp;<strong>More Nutrition&nbsp;</strong>since 2021.</p> <p><strong>ESN&nbsp;</strong>has been the German market leader in sports nutrition since 2004, offering products like protein powders, bars, and supplements designed for ambitious fitness goals. Founded in 2017,&nbsp;<strong>More Nutrition</strong>&nbsp;focuses on healthy, reduced-sugar foods, providing solutions for conscious nutrition and weight management without compromise.</p> <p>TQG’s vision is to help people become the best version of themselves. With passion and innovation, the company develops high-quality products that promote health, performance, and joy in life. description: <div class="content-intro"><h1><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>About Workato</strong></span></h1> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Workato is the leading Control and Execution Platform for Enterprise AI — the neutral platform enterprises trust to put AI to work across their business. Workato unifies data, applications, and processes into a single platform so AI can reliably orchestrate business processes in production at enterprise scale. Built on more than a decade of running mission-critical processes for over half the Fortune 500 — including Nasdaq, Amazon, Cisco, Vodafone, Atlassian, and Lucid Motors — Workato turns over 14,000 enterprise systems AI needs to act on into one governed execution layer. For more information, visit <a class="link" href="https://www.workato.com/" data-tooltip-link-label="undefined">workato.com</a>.</span></p> <h1><strong>Why join us?</strong></h1> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Ultimately, Workato believes in fostering a </span><strong>flexible, trust-oriented culture that empowers everyone to take full ownership of their roles</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">. We are driven by </span><strong>innovation </strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">and looking for</span><strong> team players </strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">who want to actively build our company.&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">But, we also believe in </span><strong>balancing productivity with self-care</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">. That’s why we offer all of our employees a vibrant and dynamic work environment </span><a href="http://www.workato.com/careers"><span style="font-weight: 400;">along with a multitude of benefits</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> they can enjoy inside and outside of their work lives.&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">If this sounds right up your alley, please submit an application. We look forward to getting to know you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Also, feel free to check out why:</span></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"> <p><a href="https://www.businessinsider.com/47-enterprise-startups-to-bet-your-career-on-in-2020-2019-12"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Business Insider</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> named us an “enterprise startup to bet your career on”</span></p> </li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"> <p><a href="https://www.forbes.com/cloud100/#a57477b5f941"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Forbes’ Cloud 100</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> recognized us as one of the top 100 private cloud companies in the world</span></p> </li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"> <p><a workers</span></p> </li> </ul></div><h1><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h1> <p>On the back of high customer demand and as part of our ongoing and successful Professional Services build out in EMEA, we are looking for an exceptional <strong>Technical Architect, </strong>experienced in SAP projects.</p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">In this role, y</span><span style="font-weight: 400;">ou solution, architecture and implementation perspective for the Workato platform.</p> </li> <li> <p>Contributing to our global SAP practice by creating or enhancing content such as Workato Community orchestration or adoption of other Workato platform features</p> </li> </ul> <h1><strong>Requirements</strong></h1> <h3><strong>Qualifications / Experience / Technical Skills</strong></h3> <ul> <li> raw.title: Forward Deployed Engineer - EMEA
raw.description:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

🎯 Your main goal will be to turn n8n’s most strategic enterprise deployments into production-ready success stories by embedding on-site, solving real customer problems, and building reusable automation patterns that shape our product.

To do so, you’ll work directly with customers, Deployment Strategists, and Product to make every engagement high-impact, scalable, and repeatable:

Drive high-impact enterprise deployments

Embed on-site with enterprise customers for focused 5-day deployment engagements, arriving with a hypothesis and leaving with production workflows in place.

Partner closely with Deployment Strategists to align technical execution with customer priorities, stakeholder needs, and adoption goals.

Build trust with technical and non-technical stakeholders by turning complex customer environments into clear, actionable solutions.

Build production-grade automation solutions

Design and build workflows, integrations, and custom nodes tailored to each customer’s environment and scalable beyond the initial use case.

Extend existing n8n nodes or add missing functionality where needed to unlock high-value enterprise use cases.

Translate ambiguous business problems into concrete automation designs that prioritize real customer value over technical complexity.

Work across industries and tech stacks, getting productive quickly in new environments.

Bridge customer needs with Product and Engineering

Identify when a bespoke customer requirement should become a reusable node improvement, product feature, or platform capability.

Create a clear feedback loop with Product and Engineering by documenting technical gaps, customer context, implementation learnings, and prioritization signals.

Contribute reusable learnings, workflows, custom nodes, and integration patterns to an internal playbook library.

Turn customer learnings into product and playbooks

Identify when a bespoke customer requirement should become a core product feature and document it clearly for Product.

Contribute reusable learnings, workflows, and patterns to an internal playbook library.

Help ensure every engagement makes the next one faster, stronger, and more productized.

Keep engagements focused and scalable

Deliver time-boxed customer engagements with clear outcomes, rather than open-ended professional services work.

Build solutions that customers can own and operate themselves.

Know when to build, when to simplify, and when to push back to avoid unnecessary complexity.

REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

🧑‍💻 Strong engineering background: You have solid full-stack or backend engineering experience and have built integrations, APIs, or automation pipelines in production environments.

🧩 Integration-building expertise: You can create custom nodes, extend existing integrations, and work confidently with APIs, authentication patterns, data models, and event-driven systems.

🔧 Product-minded technical execution: You can distinguish between a one-off customer workaround, a reusable node improvement, and a product feature worth escalating.

🤝 Customer-facing confidence: You’re comfortable working directly in customer environments and can build trust with engineers, operators, and non-technical stakeholders.

🗺️ Solution design skills: You can take a messy operational problem and turn it into a clean, practical technical design.

⚖️ Strong technical judgment: You know when to build, when to push back, and how to avoid gold-plating solutions that should stay simple.

✈️ Willingness to travel: You’re open to travelling roughly 30-50% of the time for on-site engagements, primarily across Europe.

⚡ Speed to productive: You can quickly understand new industries, tech stacks, and customer environments without needing everything to be neatly defined.

Nice-to-haves

🔁 Workflow automation experience: You have familiarity with n8n or similar workflow automation tools.

🏢 Enterprise deployment experience: You’ve worked with strategic enterprise accounts in complex technical environments.

🧱 Node or connector development: You’ve built custom nodes, connectors, plugins, SDKs, or reusable integration frameworks.

🚀 Forward deployed experience: You’ve worked in a forward deployed, solutions engineering, or similar role at a product-led technical organization.

📣 Product feedback experience: You’ve helped turn customer learnings into clear product feedback, roadmap input, or engineering specifications.

Why join us?

At n8n, you’ll be the founding Forward Deployed Engineer, helping define how we turn our largest enterprise deployments into long-term, referenceable success stories. Your work won’t sit in a demo environment — you’ll build production workflows with real users, influence our product roadmap, and create the playbooks that shape how this function scales.

You’ll join one of Europe’s fastest-growing startups at a moment of huge momentum, working with a remote-first team that values autonomy, speed, experimentation, and direct customer impact.

Sound like a challenge you’re excited to take on?

Apply now — and help us build the future of automation.

n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work.

Our company language is English.

You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n (https://www.notion.so/n8n/Diversity-inclusion-and-belonging-n8n-c1bec2fff536422d868b1a438d990e35).

Location disclaimer: If you see multiple job postings for the same role, it is most likely because we're hiring remotely for this role and posting in different locations to make sure every potential candidate can see the role. Please apply to the location you're the most likely to work from in the future.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation 💸 – We offer fair and attractive pay.

  • Ownership 💪 – Our core value is to “empower others,” and we mean it—you’ll get a slice of n8n with equity.

  • Work/life balance 🏖️ – We work hard but ensure you have time to recharge:

    • Europe: 30 days of vacation, plus public holidays wherever you are.

    • US: 20 vacation days, 8 sick days, plus public holidays wherever you are.

  • Health & wellness 🩺 –

    • Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*

    • US: Multiple low-premium, low-deductible medical plans with coverage for individuals and families—plus a no-cost premium HDHP option with a pre-seeded HSA—along with dental and vision coverage.

  • Future planning 💰 –

    • Europe: We provide pension contributions according to local country norms.*

    • US: 401(k) retirement plan with a 4% employer match.

  • Financial security 🛡️ –

    • Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*

    • US: Company-paid short-term and long-term disability insurance, plus life insurance to support you and your loved ones.

  • Career growth 📈 – We hire rising stars who grow with us! You’ll get €1K (or equivalent) per year to spend on courses, books, events, or coaching to level up your skills.

  • A passionate team 🤩 – We love our product, and we prove it with regular hackathons where we see who can build the coolest thing with it!

  • Remote-first 🌏 – Our team works remotely across Europe, with regular off-sites for team bonding. Some roles, like sales in the US, are hybrid—please check the job description.

  • Giving back 🤝 – We're big fans of open source, and you'll get $100 per month to support projects you care about.

  • Transparency 🙏 – We all know what everyone’s working on, how the company is doing—the whole shebang.

* Country-specific details are provided in your contract.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform . About the role: We're hiring for Self-Managed Experience (SMX) — the team responsible for making Camunda 8 deployable in a self-service way for customers who run their own infrastructure. SMX covers two areas of work: installation artifacts (Helm chart, Docker Compose, C8Run) and reference architectures & cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure). This role sits primarily on the installation artifacts side — building, maintaining, and releasing the artifacts that ship Camunda 8 to every self-managed customer. title: Full Stack Engineer (m/f/d)
description: TL;DR Join GlassDollar and help build the system some of Europe's largest companies use to find, test, and adopt startup technology. We're looking for an engineer who wants considerably more responsibility than "implement what's in the ticket". You'll take an ambiguous problem, shape it together with product, make the important technical decisions, ship it, and stay close enough to see whether it worked. We expect you to have opinions. We also expect you to be good enough to change them. The problem we're solving Large organisations are remarkably good at accumulating problems. A company with 100,000 employees can have thousands of operational challenges across its business units. Somewhere outside that organisation, a startup has probably already built part of the solution. Getting those two things to meet still happens through spreadsheets, long email threads, and meetings whose primary output is another meeting. GlassDollar OS is the operating system for venture clienting: problem → startup discovery → evaluation → PoC → adoption, in one repeatable workflow. Our customers are some of Europe's largest organisations, so the software has to move quickly and behave like something an enterprise can depend on. That tension creates the interesting engineering problems. What we're looking for You can take a problem further than the ticket. Work often starts with something incomplete, like "customers need a better way to manage X". You'll shape the problem with product, challenge assumptions, and decide what belongs in this iteration. Strong opinions about what we build, not only how, are expected here. You care about product. You want to know who you're building for, why the problem matters, and what success looks like. That context should shape your technical decisions. You have technical judgement. There is rarely one correct architecture. You know when the boring solution beats the ambitious one, when an abstraction helps and when it hides the problem, and when a small feature is about to create six months of technical debt. We expect you to reason about API boundaries, data models, permissions, performance, failure modes, testing, observability, and rollout, and to raise concerns with a clear argument attached. You make the system better, not just the feature. You fix the spreading pattern rather than the single instance, make an API easier for the next person, and improve tests because the current setup makes everyone afraid to deploy. Your impact should show beyond the pull requests with your name on them. You can work across the stack. A feature might run from a React interaction through GraphQL into a Node service, a schema redesign, a permissions update, and a safe migration for existing customers. Curiosity to follow the problem matters more than equal depth everywhere. You own quality. We have QA. That's not where quality begins. What breaks if this request happens twice? What happens with old data, or when the API fails halfway through? We use Playwright and Jest alongside reviews and monitoring. The goal isn't coverage, it's confidence. You communicate like your decisions will matter later. Six months from now, somebody should understand an important decision without digging through seventeen Slack messages and a deleted Notion comment. That means writing things down when they matter, explaining trade-offs clearly, giving useful code reviews, and surfacing risks before they become incidents. You raise the engineering bar around you. You do not need a management title to have influence. Find the hole in an architecture, unblock someone without taking the keyboard away, disagree without turning every decision into a referendum. As you earn trust, you’ll naturally become the person people bring harder problems to. What you'll do Over your first year: Enterprise integrations: into our customers' systems, data, identity providers, and workflows. This is what turns GlassDollar from software somebody logs into, into infrastructure their organisation operates on. APIs and MCP: public REST APIs and MCP servers for our customers, their engineers, and increasingly their AI agents. The interesting part isn't exposing endpoints, it's designing an external platform we'll still be happy supporting years from now. AI inside real workflows: embeddings, vector search, and LLMs across a large database of startups and corporate innovation data. We're less interested in adding a ✨ button to everything than in finding places where AI removes real work. Workflow automation: triggers, notifications, and automation that replace humans moving information between systems. Core product engineering: React interfaces, APIs, PostgreSQL queries, permissions, migrations, performance work, and the occasional bug whose root cause makes everybody stare silently at their screen. Our stack Frontend: TypeScript, React, Material UI, Apollo Client, Playwright Backend: Node.js, GraphQL, Prisma, PostgreSQL, Jest Infrastructure: AWS, Terraform, GitHub Actions, Sentry Increasingly: LLM APIs, embeddings, vector search, MCP, AI-assisted engineering workflows You don't need experience with every item. Reasoning about systems matters more to us than having memorised our exact stack. Requirements Substantial production experience with TypeScript, React, and Node.js Comfortable reasoning about relational databases, not just the ORM Can independently take a feature from unclear starting point to production Can read unfamiliar code without immediately proposing a rewrite Nice to have: Experience with GraphQL, Prisma, or PostgreSQL at scale Exposure to LLM APIs, embeddings, or vector search Experience owning systems, not just features Don't check every box? Apply anyway. We'd rather have the conversation than lose someone over a bullet point. How we hire How we work We're a small engineering team, so there are fewer places for responsibility to disappear and no chain of five people between you and a decision. We prefer written context over meetings the calendar invented, and working software over elaborate process. Quickly doesn't mean carelessly. Sometimes the fastest route is the simple version today, sometimes it's another day on a foundation twenty future features will sit on. Knowing which situation you're in is part of the job. Expect to ship to production very early. How we hire No seven-stage endurance test. No algorithm trivia disconnected from the work. Intro. You, us, and whether this is the environment you're actually looking for. Technical conversation. We go deep on something difficult you've built: the decisions, the alternatives, what you'd do differently now. Technical assessment. Usually live coding on a realistic problem, sometimes a small proof of concept instead. We care how you think, not whether your solution matches ours. Offer. If there's strong mutual conviction, we move. One last thing Job descriptions have a habit of producing candidates who optimise themselves against bullet points. Please don't. If you're reading this thinking "I can do most of this, but I haven't worked with MCP", apply. Strong fundamentals, meaningful software shipped, and a bias toward ownership are what we're looking for. The rest is learnable. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Associate Product Owner
description: TL;DR Full-time. Berlin-based. No remote option available for this role. You sit with the PM. Join GlassDollar as an Associate Product Owner and own the space between a good idea and a shipped feature. Someone has to decide what "done" means, write it down clearly enough that an engineer can start on Monday, and stay close enough to the build that the scope does not quietly grow on the way. That is the job. You own it end to end: specs, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and a backlog that keeps everyone honest about what is actually shipping. Nobody hands you a ticket queue you did not write yourself. The problem you'll be solving A corporation with 100,000 employees has thousands of expensive operational problems, and somewhere out there a startup has already solved most of them. Getting those two facts to meet is slow, political, and mostly attempted in spreadsheets that die in someone's downloads folder. GlassDollar OS is the venture clienting platform that makes it repeatable: sourcing the startups, matching them to real problems, running the pilots, and rolling out what works across the whole organisation. Enterprise customers run real innovation budgets through it. What you scope this month decides what they can do next quarter. What we're looking for You have personally written the tickets. 3+ years in a product company, where scoping and ticket-writing were actually your job rather than something you handed off. You are technical enough to argue with engineers. AI models, API contracts, estimates, sequencing. You push back with reasons, and you change your mind when the reasons coming back are better. You can write. A spec is a piece of writing. We will ask for a sample where the reasoning is visible, polish second. You write specs worth acting on. The valuable ones pull three threads together: where the product is going, what clients are actually telling us, and the knowledge already sitting in the team. You gather all three before you write, so what lands on the board is specific enough to build and pointed enough to matter. You know what looks good. You have a great sense of design and what feels good for users. We will ask you to build a prototype with AI and illustrate the specs visually. You have worked somewhere small enough that there was nowhere to hide. No layers between you and the consequences of a bad spec. You want to be coached hard. Direct feedback, weekly, on your actual work. You will scope alongside the product lead until you are doing it alone, and the goal is that this happens fast. You are fluent with AI tooling, day to day. We want to see the workflow, not hear it described. You want the scope to grow. The people who do best here end up owning areas outright: the major initiatives, the roadmap arguments, and the questions everyone else brings their doubts to. That is earned, and it is genuinely available. What you'll do Your job: turn validated opportunities into work an engineer can start on Monday. Turning opportunities into scoped, sequenced, estimable work: specs, acceptance criteria, edge cases, dependencies Running the backlog: grooming, prioritisation input, keeping the board honest about what is in flight, blocked, or quietly drifting Being the interface between customer signal (support threads, CS conversations, call notes) and the engineering queue Coordinating releases and checking that what shipped matches what was scoped Presenting product decisions to varied stakeholder groups, from engineers to enterprise clients What you'll be scoping over your first year: Deep integrations into our customers' organisations. Their systems, their data, their identity stack. This is the work that turns GlassDollar from a tool people visit into infrastructure they run on. Public REST APIs and MCP servers , so our customers' engineers and their AI agents can build on top of us. AI embedded across the product , inside the surfaces people already work in. Workflow automation inside the platform , so the work that used to take six meetings and a shared spreadsheet runs itself. You will need to understand each of these well enough to write the spec and defend it in the room. This is a doing role rather than a people-management one. Mid-to-senior individual contributor. raw.title: Associate Product Owner
raw.description:
TL;DR

Full-time. Berlin-based. No remote option available for this role. You sit with the PM.

Join GlassDollar as an Associate Product Owner and own the space between a good idea and a shipped feature.
Someone has to decide what "done" means, write it down clearly enough that an engineer can start on Monday, and stay close enough to the build that the scope does not quietly grow on the way. That is the job. You own it end to end: specs, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and a backlog that keeps everyone honest about what is actually shipping. Nobody hands you a ticket queue you did not write yourself.

The problem you'll be solvingA corporation with 100,000 employees has thousands of expensive operational problems, and somewhere out there a startup has already solved most of them. Getting those two facts to meet is slow, political, and mostly attempted in spreadsheets that die in someone's downloads folder.
GlassDollar OS is the venture clienting platform that makes it repeatable: sourcing the startups, matching them to real problems, running the pilots, and rolling out what works across the whole organisation. Enterprise customers run real innovation budgets through it. What you scope this month decides what they can do next quarter.


What we're looking for

You have personally written the tickets.
3+ years in a product company, where scoping and ticket-writing were actually your job rather than something you handed off.
You are technical enough to argue with engineers.
AI models, API contracts, estimates, sequencing. You push back with reasons, and you change your mind when the reasons coming back are better.
You can write.
A spec is a piece of writing. We will ask for a sample where the reasoning is visible, polish second.
You write specs worth acting on.
The valuable ones pull three threads together: where the product is going, what clients are actually telling us, and the knowledge already sitting in the team. You gather all three before you write, so what lands on the board is specific enough to build and pointed enough to matter.
You know what looks good.
You have a great sense of design and what feels good for users. We will ask you to build a prototype with AI and illustrate the specs visually.
You have worked somewhere small enough that there was nowhere to hide.
No layers between you and the consequences of a bad spec.
You want to be coached hard.
Direct feedback, weekly, on your actual work. You will scope alongside the product lead until you are doing it alone, and the goal is that this happens fast.
You are fluent with AI tooling, day to day.
We want to see the workflow, not hear it described.
You want the scope to grow.
The people who do best here end up owning areas outright: the major initiatives, the roadmap arguments, and the questions everyone else brings their doubts to. That is earned, and it is genuinely available.


What you'll do

Your job: turn validated opportunities into work an engineer can start on Monday.

  • Turning opportunities into scoped, sequenced, estimable work: specs, acceptance criteria, edge cases, dependencies
  • Running the backlog: grooming, prioritisation input, keeping the board honest about what is in flight, blocked, or quietly drifting
  • Being the interface between customer signal (support threads, CS conversations, call notes) and the engineering queue
  • Coordinating releases and checking that what shipped matches what was scoped
  • Presenting product decisions to varied stakeholder groups, from engineers to enterprise clients

What you'll be scoping over your first year:
  • Deep integrations into our customers' organisations. Their systems, their data, their identity stack. This is the work that turns GlassDollar from a tool people visit into infrastructure they run on.
  • Public REST APIs and MCP servers, so our customers' engineers and their AI agents can build on top of us.
  • AI embedded across the product, inside the surfaces people already work in.
  • Workflow automation inside the platform, so the work that used to take six meetings and a shared spreadsheet runs itself.
You will need to understand each of these well enough to write the spec and defend it in the room.
This is a doing role rather than a people-management one. Mid-to-senior individual contributor.


Requirements

  • 3+ years in a product company, where you personally wrote the tickets
  • Technical enough to understand a data model, an API contract, and estimation
  • Demonstrable writing ability, be ready to share a spec, PRD or decision doc
Nice to have:
  • B2B enterprise SaaS background
  • Familiarity with venture clienting, corporate innovation, or startup-scouting workflows
  • Notion fluency

Don't check every box? Apply anyway. We care more about the questions you ask about a brief than the answer you land on.


How we hire

Straightforward. Respectful of your time. No mystery steps.

  1. Intro call: a quick chat to see if there's a match
  2. Interview with the PM, including a brief introduction to the work sample: a spec, PRD, or decision doc where your reasoning is visible, plus examples of problems you've framed
  3. Interview
  4. Offer: if it clicks, we don't wait around

Du kannst IT – vom Client bis zur komplexen Infrastruktur. Gleichzeitig verstehst du Kunden, erkennst Verbesserungspotenziale und entwickelst Lösungen, die technisch und wirtschaftlich sinnvoll sind.
Deine Rolle

  • Du betreust mittelständische Kunden in der Region Hannover und entwickelst ihre IT aktiv weiter.
  • Du analysierst bestehende IT-Strukturen, erkennst Risiken und Verbesserungspotenziale und setzt passende Lösungen um.
  • Du packst selbst mit an: Systeme konfigurieren, Fehler beheben – Hands-on gehört für dich dazu.
  • Du übernimmst Verantwortung, erklärst technische Themen verständlich und bindest bei Bedarf Spezialisten oder Vertrieb ein.
Was uns wichtig ist
  • Mehrjährige praktische IT-Erfahrung – Zertifikate sind für uns nicht das Entscheidende.
  • Du bist Allrounder: keine Scheu vor operativer Technik, aber auch in der Lage, komplexe Strukturen zu durchdringen.
  • Offenheit für KI und neue Werkzeuge – für Automatisierung, bessere Prozesse und neue Lösungen.
  • Souveräner Umgang mit Kunden und Entscheidern sowie eine klare, verständliche Kommunikation.
  • Eigeninitiative, Verantwortungsbewusstsein und der Blick dafür, wo IT besser, sicherer oder effizienter werden kann.
Was du bei uns bekommst
  • Viel Gestaltungsspielraum und echte Kundenverantwortung
  • Spannende Projekte im Mittelstand und ein starkes technisches Team im Rücken
  • Flexible Mischung aus Homeoffice, Büro und regionalen Kundenterminen
  • Individuelle Weiterentwicklung und Raum, neue Technologien sinnvoll einzusetzen
  • Hansefit, JobRad, betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Kinderbetreuungszuschuss und Team-Events
Technisch solltest du dich hier sicher bewegen
  • Microsoft Windows Client & Server sowie Microsoft 365
  • Active Directory, Gruppenrichtlinien, DNS/DHCP und klassische Microsoft-Infrastrukturen
  • Installation und Konfiguration von Sophos Firewalls
  • Backup und Datensicherung mit Veeam
  • E-Mail-Security / Security-Lösungen von Hornetsecurity
  • Netzwerkgrundlagen, Virtualisierung und typische IT-Umgebungen im Mittelstand
  • PowerShell und Automatisierung sind ein Plus
Klingt nach dir?
Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen.

Je mehr Vielfalt wir bei der Analyse von Daten unserer Kunden und des Rests der Welt haben, desto vielfältiger sind unsere Erkenntnisse und desto besser sind die Verbesserungen, die wir erzielen können. Wir suchen nach Leidenschaft für das Thema... zeig uns deine!   Eine Anleitung und Hilfestellung zu unserem Bewerbungsprozess findest du hier . Schau dir auch gern die Bewerbunsgdashboards an, die in der Vergangenheit erfolgreich waren. Wenn du dich vorab auf das Thema Datenanalyse vorbereiten möchtest, ist unser Youtube Channel eine großartige Ressource, denn hier bieten wir dir regelmäßig Lerninhalte für Tableau. You’ll sit in the room with senior client stakeholders, including CMOs, and turn their challenges into operating models, workflows and commercial models (team shapes, asset rates, outcome-based structures) that we can deliver. You’ll bring the commercial judgement to validate the numbers, the process thinking to design better ways of working, and the technical and channel knowledge to lead the conversation when specialists aren’t there. Quick on your feet and calm under pressure, you’ll be supported by our Commercial and Implementation teams.</p> <h4>&nbsp;</h4> <h4>Key Responsibilities:</h4> <h4>New Business and Client Engagement</h4> <ul> <li>Lead the operational and solution design element of new client pitches, presenting with credibility and confidence to senior client stakeholders, including CMOs and marketing leadership.</li> <li>Formulate solutions in real time during pitches, workshops and challenging client discussions, staying composed and commercially sharp.</li> <li>Own the conversation on technology and data when technical specialists aren’t present, and know when and how to bring them in.</li> <li>Ensure a smooth handover from pitch to implementation, so what we sell is what we deliver.</li> </ul> <h4>Requirement Gathering and Analysis</h4> <ul> <li>Work with stakeholders to gather, document and analyse business requirements for new client accounts.</li> <li>Ask the right questions to define accurate scope, cost and risk.</li> <li>Translate client business needs into workflows for client and technology teams.</li> </ul> <h4>Operating Model and Solution Design</h4> <ul> <li>Define and articulate operating model principles (roles, governance, ways of working, handoffs) that align to client goals and our delivery capability.</li> <li>Evaluate existing client and internal processes, identify new ways of working, and recommend improvements for efficiency, cost reduction and better outcomes.</li> <li>Design solutions across advertising and marketing channels, drawing on a strong understanding of how media, data, creative and technology fit together.</li> <li>Collaborate with technology and business teams to ensure solutions align with our strategy and are technically feasible.</li> </ul> <h4>Commercial Modelling</h4> <ul> <li>Build, test and validate commercial models that deliver the designed workflow, including team shapes, asset-based rate models and outcome-based models.</li> <li>Work with Commercial and Finance to pressure-test assumptions, margins and risk before models go to clients.</li> <li>Balance client value with commercial viability, and explain the reasoning clearly to both internal and client audiences.</li> </ul> <h4>Stakeholder Communication</h4> <ul> <li>Act as the bridge between clients, commercial, technology and delivery teams, ensuring shared understanding and alignment.</li> <li>Translate complex technical and commercial concepts into clear, compelling narratives for non-technical, senior audiences.</li> </ul> <h4>Data, Measurement and Reporting</h4> <ul> <li>Analyse data to support decision-making, and define measurement frameworks for new clients.</li> <li>Create reports and presentations that convey findings and recommendations with clarity and impact.</li> </ul> <h4>&nbsp;</h4> <h4>About You:</h4> <h4>Essential</h4> <ul> <li>10-15 years’ experience in solution design, consulting, strategy, operations or a similar role within advertising, marketing, media or marketing technology.</li> <li>A confident, articulate communicator with a track record of presenting to and influencing C-suite and senior marketing stakeholders (CMOs or equivalent).</li> <li>Commercial acumen, with hands-on experience building and validating pricing or commercial models (e.g. resourcing/team-shape models, rate cards, outcome-based or performance-linked structures).</li> <li>A process-driven mindset, able to map, challenge and redesign ways of working and articulate clear operating model principles.</li> <li>Strong working knowledge of advertising and marketing channels (e.g. paid media, social, programmatic, search, CRM, creative production) and how they connect to data and technology.</li> <li>Enough technical fluency in martech, adtech, data and platforms to hold credible conversations with clients and lead when technical specialists aren’t in the room.</li> <li>Quick-thinking and resilient, comfortable formulating answers and options in high-pressure or contentious situations while maintaining client confidence.</li> <li>Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn data into insight and recommendations.</li> <li>Willingness and flexibility to travel regularly for client pitches, mostly across Europe and occasionally further afield.</li> </ul> <h4>Desirable</h4> <ul> <li>Experience contributing to new business wins, RFPs and pitch processes.</li> <li>Experience in an agency, consultancy or in-house marketing transformation environment.</li> <li>Experience with global or multi-market clients and remote, cross-functional teams.</li> </ul> <h4>&nbsp;</h4> <h4>What Success Looks Like:</h4> <ul> <li>Contribute directly to new business wins and improve pitch win rates.</li> <li>Commercial models that are profitable, credible to clients and deliverable in practice.</li> <li>Smooth transitions from pitch to implementation with no gap Location This is a full-time position based at our HQ in Munich or Cologne. About the role You solve the hard technical problems on live systems. Once a customer is running on blp, their processes are business critical. Invoices post or they do not. Orders flow or they sit. Our support organisation resolves most of what comes in, and a lot of it is genuinely well handled by people early in their career. What is left is yours: the cases where the cause is not obvious, where it crosses systems, data and process logic at once, where the same symptom has three possible explanations and only one of them is right. It might be better self-service for customers, a customer-facing assistant that resolves the routine questions before they reach us, better diagnostics, or a change in how something is configured at deployment so the problem never occurs. You are expected to find those, make the case, and drive them through. That is how a support organisation scales without scaling headcount one for one, and it is value the customer feels directly. Location

This is a full-time position based at our HQ in Munich or Cologne.

About the role

You solve the hard technical problems on live systems.

Once a customer is running on blp, their processes are business critical. Invoices post or they do not. Orders flow or they sit. Our support organisation resolves most of what comes in, and a lot of it is genuinely well handled by people early in their career. What is left is yours: the cases where the cause is not obvious, where it crosses systems, data and process logic at once, where the same symptom has three possible explanations and only one of them is right.

That is the job. Not a queue, and not the easy half of one. Everything difficult that comes out of the run phase lands with you.

Two things sit alongside the case work, and they are what make this a senior job rather than a harder version of a junior one.

Stabilising accounts
When an account's health goes bad, you go in and stabilise it. Not as a permanent assignment, but as a small, highly skilled squad that takes a customer whose numbers or whose confidence have slipped, works out what is actually wrong across the whole picture, fixes it, and hands back a customer who is running properly again. It is the most concentrated version of this work there is.

Taking effort out permanently
Anything that keeps arriving in the queue is a signal, and the answer is usually not more people answering it. It might be better self-service for customers, a customer-facing assistant that resolves the routine questions before they reach us, better diagnostics, or a change in how something is configured at deployment so the problem never occurs. You are expected to find those, make the case, and drive them through. That is how a support organisation scales without scaling headcount one for one, and it is value the customer feels directly.

You work across the boundary between what our platform does, what the customer's ERP does, and what their data actually looks like. You are the one who can read a failing case end to end and say what really happened, and then say credibly whether the fix is configuration, data, process, or a genuine product issue. When it is a product issue, you are the counterpart to our engineering and product teams: you bring the evidence, and because you have seen the same structural problem across several customers, your case is the one that moves the roadmap.

You are also how this function gets better rather than just bigger. The diagnostic tooling, the patterns, the documentation that lets a first-year person resolve what used to take a senior one: that is yours to build. And the interns and specialists coming through the team learn this craft from you.

You do not deliver integrations and you do not run go-lives. Our integrations engineers and technical project managers own that. You own what happens once it is live and it is challenging.

What you'll do

  • Own the technically difficult cases from our live customer base, end to end, to a verified root cause.

  • Diagnose across boundaries: platform behaviour, ERP behaviour, master data and process logic.

  • Decide what the real fix is, and make it: configuration, data, process, or a case for engineering.

  • Go into accounts with a deteriorating health score, diagnose across the whole picture, stabilise them and hand them back running properly.

  • Drive strategic initiatives that permanently reduce effort and improve the customer experience, from better diagnostics to customer-facing self-service and assistants.

  • Act as the counterpart to Product and Engineering, with evidence strong enough to change priorities.

  • Recognise structural problems across customers and push for them to be solved once.

  • Build the diagnostic tooling, patterns and documentation that raise what the rest of the team can resolve alone.

  • Mentor interns and earlier-career colleagues, and raise the technical bar of the function.

  • Support Consultants and Customer Success Managers on the technical substance of customer escalations.

What we're really looking for

The following key attributes ensure success in this role:

  • Root Cause, Not Symptom – You are not finished when it stops happening. You are finished when you know why.

  • Cross-Boundary Reasoning – You hold platform, ERP, data and process in your head at once and find where the truth is.

  • Credible Both Ways – You explain the same problem to an engineer and to a CFO, and both of them believe you.

  • Leverage – Your instinct is to remove the next hundred cases, not only to close this one. You would rather build the thing that makes a problem stop arriving.

  • Calm Under Escalation – When a business-critical process is stopped, you get more precise rather than faster.

  • Stabilizer Under Pressure: An unhappy client is not a fire to put out. It is a relationship to rebuild. You bring the temperature down, put structure back into the account, and align next steps so trust returns, not just silence

What you'll bring

  • Master's degree in a STEM field: computer science, engineering, information systems, mathematics, physics or similar. Strong candidates from a related field are welcome to make their case.

  • 3+ years in a technical customer-facing role: application support at depth, technical consulting, solution engineering, integration engineering or equivalent.

  • Demonstrable debugging ability across systems, not only within one. APIs, data mapping, interfaces, logs.

  • Comfortable with data. SQL or equivalent, and the instinct to check rather than assume.

  • German and English, both fluent. This is a hard requirement. Our customers work in German every day and our internal work runs in English.

  • Nice to have: ERP experience with SAP, Microsoft Dynamics or similar, scripting in any language, or exposure to workflow automation and process mining.

What you'll get

  • The hard problems, not the queue.

  • Influence on the product, with a direct line to Engineering and Product.

  • Room to shape the function, since the practice is still being built.

  • Real growth – the path from here leads into Consulting, technical leadership within Customer Success, or Product.

  • Employee ownership – be part of a majority employee-owned company with a best-in-class stock option programme.

  • Amazing team – become part of a driven and collaborative group of innovators.

  • Visits & offsites – including collaborative team offsites.

A drive to get things done in a collaborative, agile environment , comfortable navigating the complexity of a multi-TSO, decentralised grid, and comfortable being the regional face of a technical function whose deep build sits with a partner team in the UK. ⭐️ Bonus points Knowledge of industrial communication protocols: IEC 60870-5-104, IEC 61400-25 (wind), OPC-UA, Modbus , or similar IEC protocols. description: <p class="p1"><strong>Firmus Technologies</strong></p> <p class="p2">Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the development and operation of efficient AI&nbsp;infrastructure from model to grid. Founded in Australia in 2019, our mission is to create the most&nbsp;efficient AI infrastructure by combining cutting-edge technology with a steadfast commitment to&nbsp;sustainability.</p> <p class="p2">At Firmus, we are unique in our approach. We design, build, and operate a new class of digital&nbsp;infrastructure – the AI Factory. Through our model-to-grid technology approach, we have pushed the&nbsp;boundaries of multi-generational liquid cooling systems, energy management, AI software&nbsp;orchestration, and construction. This co-designed approach from model to grid allows us to make&nbsp;every watt count and deliver low-cost AI tokens globally.</p> <p class="p2">&nbsp;</p> <p class="p1"><strong>Firmus AI Cloud</strong></p> <p class="p2">Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built to deliver energy-efficient AI&nbsp;compute at scale. It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government&nbsp;users to train and deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is&nbsp;market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale.</p> <p class="p2">&nbsp;</p> <p class="p1"><strong>Why you’ll love working here</strong></p> <p class="p2">At Firmus, you’ll work at the intersection of sustainability and artificial intelligence in a fast-paced&nbsp;environment powered by next-generation technology. You’ll be helping to transform an entire&nbsp;industry — and you’ll feel it every day.</p> <p class="p2">Our team is made up of true innovators and leaders in their fields, and as an emerging company, you&nbsp;won’t be lost in a crowd. You’ll work closely with the founders, build a strong network, and see the&nbsp;impact of your work first-hand as we democratise AI tools for everyone — more sustainably and&nbsp;more affordably.</p> <p class="p2">We believe great things happen when people from diverse backgrounds come together to do their&nbsp;best work and be their authentic selves. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="No Spacing">ROLE</span></span></strong></p> <p><span class="TextRun SCXW245217756 BCX4" lang="EN-AU" data-contrast="none"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW245217756 BCX4" data-ccp-parastyle="No Spacing">Firmus Technologies is seeking an Engineering Manager to lead the Platform Engineering and Observability team. You are accountable for both the people and the delivery: the engineers you grow and the platform software they ship. Your team builds and </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW245217756 BCX4" data-ccp-parastyle="No Spacing">operates</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW245217756 BCX4" data-ccp-parastyle="No Spacing"> the platform beneath the Firmus AI Cloud, from bare-metal GPU compute and high-performance networking to the internal platform services, self-service tooling, and the observability platform that our engineering teams and customers depend on. You run these as products for the engineering teams that build on them, investing in self-service, reliability, and developer experience. You are the escalation point above first-line operations and own the cross-cutting decisions your team shares. This is a build-and-grow leadership role: you build the team that scales our AI platform toward gigawatt-scale AI factories across the regions and grow your scope as you earn it.</span></span><span class="EOP Selected SCXW245217756 BCX4" data-ccp-props="{&quot;335551550&quot;:6,&quot;335551620&quot;:6}">&nbsp;</span><br>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="No Spacing">KEY RESPONSIBILITIES</span></span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;335551550&quot;:6,&quot;335551620&quot;:6}">&nbsp;</span></strong></p> <ul> <li data-leveltext="" data-font="Symbol" data-listid="5" data-list-defn-props="{&quot;335551500&quot;:2448933,&quot;335552541&quot;:1,&quot;335559685&quot;:720,&quot;335559991&quot;:360,&quot;469769226&quot;:&quot;Symbol&quot;,&quot;469769242&quot;:[8226],&quot;469777803&quot;:&quot;left&quot;,&quot;469777804&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;469777815&quot;:&quot;hybridMultilevel&quot;}" data-aria-posinset="1" data-aria-level="1"><strong><span data-contrast="none">Team Leadership &amp; Growth</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335551550&quot;:6,&quot;335551620&quot;:6,&quot;335559739&quot;:120,&quot;335559740&quot;:252}">&nbsp;</span></li> </ul> <p><span data-contrast="none">Be the Single-Threaded Owner (STO) for multiple squads: their engineers and tech leads report to you, and you work alongside product, architecture, and delivery peers. Hire strong engineers, develop them through coaching and clear feedback, and manage performance directly.
